theme: One open day on the water.
greeting: The calendar's nearly empty, Dan — a quick review with Mike, then the day is your own. The girls are with Jen this cycle, and you're aboard the charter for the week.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out — and the Pathfinder heads south in October. Book it refundable this week while inventory holds.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat transfers and checkout
needsAttention.detail: Charter ends noon Sat Sept 19 at Komolac; the Komolac-to-Cavtat transfer, a bag hold, and a 5:15 AM airport run for Sunday's flight still need arranging. Do it whenever you have signal ashore — the hotel's free-cancellation window closes Sept 15.

inbox.noise: All marketing today — suits, linens, bakeware, a hot-tub pitch, a few newsletters, and two random LinkedIn invites.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Chicken and Chickpea Tagine
recipe.why: A warm, slow-simmered braise that suits the first cooling days of autumn.

tasks.title: Book Sept 20 - Oct 5 rental car (Full-Size SUV, TPA)

acts.line: A 15-minute review with Mike at 9 — the only thing on the calendar all day.
Open water; not a single event booked.
A quiet close, and tomorrow's calendar is clear too.
